meta.name: claw-background-jobs
meta.description:
Claw background job management using x agent run and x agent job.
Use when the agent needs to offload tasks. As Manager in an interactive terminal, offload aggressively — almost everything beyond a single quick command should run in the background.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将耗时任务放到后台异步执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在终端中运行长时间任务而不想阻塞当前会话。
copy.tagline_en: Offload long-running tasks to background jobs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run long tasks in terminal and want to keep your session free.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把耗时的多步任务（如文件操作、数据分析、API 调用）放到后台异步执行，自己立即回复用户“已启动”，不再等待或监控。
howto.when: 当用户提出需要多步完成的任务（如数据处理、研究、外部调用）时触发；单条简单命令（<10秒）不触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个CSV文件，找出销售趋势。
say.note: 任务会被放到后台，Claude 立即回复确认。

say.text: 调用天气API，获取未来一周的预报。
say.note: 后台执行，完成后通过心跳通知。

howto.what_en: Claude offloads multi-step tasks (file ops, data analysis, API calls) to run asynchronously in the background, immediately acknowledges the user, and does not wait or monitor.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a non-trivial multi-step task (e.g., data processing, research, external API calls). Single simple commands (<10s) are not offloaded.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV file and find sales trends.
say_en.note: Task runs in background; Claude confirms immediately.

say_en.text: Call the weather API and get forecasts for the next week.
say_en.note: Executed in background; results reported via heartbeat.
